_comment: Ecruteak City. The rival got washed by the Dancers, the Burned Tower legend.
0: Ecruteak used to have two towers, one\neast and one west.\rNow it's one tower and a crispy one.\nInsurance ain't cover it.
1: They talkin' about rebuildin' the Burned\nTower? Two towers again!\rThey been sayin' that since '87.\nCity contract. You know how it go.
2: Hmm... I think I just heard a woman\nscreamin'...\rIs that just me? It's always just me.\nMy doctor say it's “stress.”
3: The Dancers ALWAYS rehearsin' at the\nDance Theater.\rI watched for six hours. I'm not a creep.\nI'm a fan. There's a difference.
4: I'm finna rehearse at the Dance Theater.\nWanna come? I do interpretive dance.\fI interpret bills I can't pay.
5: The tower that used to be here...\nIt was WAY taller before it burned.\rNow it's a fixer-upper. Big time.
6: Three big homies ran off in three\ndifferent directions!\rWhat WAS that?! Like a family reunion\nwhen the check come.
7: They gon' start rebuildin' this tower\nSOON! Any year now. Any decade.
8: Oh! That's a nice homie you walkin'\nwith! They lift you up, don't they?\rLike a light in the dark.\rSpeakin' of lights, the Lighthouse homie\nin Olivine got sick.\fNow the boats crashin'. Shipping\fdelayed. My package LATE.
9: The Lighthouse homie in Olivine all\nbetter!\rBoats sailin' at night again.\nMy package FINALLY came. It's socks.
10: Go west from this city and you\nhit a port called Olivine City.\rWhen your homie learn Hydrant Wave,\nyou can hit the ocean from\fRoute 40 without no boat!
12: Ecruteak City Block\nBoss: Morty\fSees the Future. Still Late Though.
14: Burned Tower\nDestroyed by a mysterious fire.\rStay away, it's unsafe.\nWe mean it this time.
15: Barrier Station to Bell Tower\nNo Trespassin' for the Unworthy
